description: Passkey evidence vectors (docs/specs/passkey-evidence.md): chains, instructions, batch approvals and trust anchor key log replay. `keyLogs` maps the trust anchor DID to its key log; a case with its own `keyLogs` uses that map instead. `expected` is the Python verifier's result; the TypeScript verifier must agree.
